           CINERARIA MARITIMA

         Dusty Miller

        (CINERARIA)


Has some reputation in the cure of cataract and corneal opacities. Is
        used externally, by instilling into the eye one drop four or five times a day. This must be
        kept up for several months. Most effective in traumatic cases. Compare in cataract   Phosph; Platanus; Cannabis; Causticum; Naphthalin; Ledum; Nat mur; Silica  .
